meta.title: Sticker TODO
meta.description: A bilingual (中文 / English) personal todo board in the sidebar with sticky-board and minimal-list views: a composer dialog, quick due dates, timed reminders, font choices, tag grouping, smooth motion, and AI planning, tagging and pick-or-type per-note advice. Since 1.7.0 it also remembers: a postponement/completion history, editable preferences, a weekly review, and a coach conversation that survives restarts. 1.8.0 classifies only untagged notes and adds 「交给 DSH」to drop a note into the main chat draft.
